entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please have your order number ready.
I need to start a return. Order number is VF-881-C9.

Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. I can certainly help you with that. Let me just pull up that order... VF-881-C9. Okay, I see it's for the Trailblazer Helmet. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue?
There's no issue. I just need to return it. Is it within the return window, yes or no?
I can definitely check that for you. So it's not a technical fault, just a preference change?
The color wasn't what I expected. The box is unopened. I just need a shipping label.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. I see the helmet was delivered 38 days ago. Let me just review our policy here.
Look, I don't have a lot of time. Can you just tell me if I can send it back?

Yes, absolutely. My apologies. Rider safety is our top priority, and since the item is new, we can process that. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I've gone ahead and authorized the return for you.
Great. So the label is coming to my email?
That's correct. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid return label in the next few minutes. Just attach that to the original packaging and drop it off.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
